reason: One write pass at rest over each per-revision Service of a revision, stored as the apiserver holds it after the create, and over the pair through EnsurePerRevisionServices, which reads the revision's ControllerRevision as well. The cache stand-in hands out a copy on every Get, as the manager's cache does; the pass renders the desired Service and compares its five owned fields with the copy field by field, so nothing is copied or walked by reflection. A pass at rest writes nothing.
